title: Online Stock Span
summary: Create a StockSpanner and call next(price) for each day.

contractDetails.constraints: At most 10000 calls. Each price is in [1,100000]. Construct once and serialize every next return in call order.
contractDetails.output-checking: Construct StockSpanner once. Call next(price) for each prices entry and serialize each return in order. R uses the quoted `next` member.

statement: Create a StockSpanner and call next(price) for each day. Return the number of consecutive days ending today whose prices are at most today’s price, including today.

examples.explanation: The final quote covers all four days.
Equal prices count toward the span.

constraints: At most 10000 calls. Each price is in [1,100000]. Construct once and serialize every next return in call order.
hints: Conceptual: A higher current price can absorb earlier groups of days.
Directional: Keep decreasing prices with the span represented by each entry.
Implementation: Pop entries whose price is at most the new price, add their spans to one, then push the new price and combined span.
complexityAnalysis: O(1) amortized time per call, O(n) worst-case for one call, O(n) storage.
